newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June sugar exports ex-CS ports up on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June sugar exports ex-CS ports up on 1996.

text.p: Brazil sugar shipments out of key ports in the center-south region reached 441,825 tonnes in June, around 50 percent higher than the 294,981 tonnes shipped in June last year, according to port statistics.

Santos regained its position as the top sugar exporting port after Paranagua had handled most exports during May following the delivery of 260,000 long tons of Paranagua raws against the New York May contract.
The June total brings shipments from key center-south ports in the first two months of the crop year to 559,991 tonnes against 403,078 tonnes in May and June 1996.
